messages:
Lena Park: Quick brainstorm: product wants a concise spec for "evacuation choreography" as part of the soft-affinity roadmap. Need launch gates, minimal rollback, and a customer-ready migration checklist.
Ravi Singh: By evacuation choreography you mean how we move tenants off a degraded region with minimal impact, correct?
Lena Park: Yes. Two modes: graceful (move affinity gradually) and emergency (force global-fallback). Both need clear telemetry and RBAC.
Omar Reyes: Infra constraints: we must ensure route-table versioning, atomic affinity writes, and idempotent migration jobs. Also need fast detection for regional degradation to trigger evacuation.
Zoe Martin: Product asks: customers must opt-in for graceful migration. For emergency evacuation we need contract language that covers involuntary failover and potential egress costs. CS must approve messaging.
Henrik Olsen: Telemetry checklist before canary: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, fallback-hit-rate, re-sent requests count, egress GiB per tenant, and a drift metric comparing expected vs actual affinity distribution. Dashboards + alerting required.
Ravi Singh: Proposed canary gates: start with a dry-run (affinity KV updates but no traffic change) for 24h. Then 0.5% traffic canary for 12h; if p95 latency delta <=10% and error delta <=0.5pp, ramp to 5% for 6h, then 25% for 3h, then full.
Omar Reyes: Implementation detail: dry-run must generate audit events and a preview API for CS/AE to validate. Also need a reversible epoch tag in route-table so rollback is simple: set route-table vN -> vN-1.
Zoe Martin: Customer acceptance criteria for pilot: CS sign-off, legal residency check, billing impact visibility, and a rollback SLA (we commit to rollback within X minutes on request).
Henrik Olsen: Ops playbook highlights: run preflight capacity check, run synthetic traffic test for target fallback region, capture traces for last 30m, and have an emergency kill-switch command.
Lena Park: Example preflight command and emergency command for ops:
```bash
# preflight capacity validation
redwoodctl routing preflight --tenant t-42 --target-region eu-west-1
# emergency force fallback
redwoodctl routing force-fallback --tenant t-42 --reason "region-degraded" --ttl 3600
```
Ravi Singh: Security/RBAC note: force-fallback requires infra-admin role and must log audit id. No manual CLI fallback without two-person approval in prod.
Omar Reyes: Cost delta: initial estimate ~8% for small pilot (3 tenants) due to headroom & cross-region egress. Will run a finer model for varying traffic shapes.
Zoe Martin: I'll draft customer-facing pilot invite and a short FAQ about evacuation behaviour and billing. Henrik, can you draft the ops runbook skeleton?
Henrik Olsen: On it. Will include rolling steps, verification queries, alert thresholds, and rollback commands.
Lena Park: Action items: 1) Omar - spike atomic affinity + dry-run (due Fri) 2) Henrik - ops runbook draft (due Mon) 3) Zoe - pilot invite + legal check (due Mon) 4) Ravi - canary gate doc + RBAC proposal (due Thu).
Ravi Singh: Scheduling: propose endpoint gate review next Wednesday 9am PT.
Lena Park: OK booked. If gates pass we put evacuation choreography and soft-affinity into the platform roadmap and schedule a 3-customer pilot for Q3. :rocket:
